# Footnotes

A sentence with a footnote.[^first] Another one refers to a named
note[^named] and the first again.[^first]

A third paragraph cites a long note.[^long]

[^first]: The first footnote with *emphasis*.

[^named]: A named footnote containing `code` and a [link](guide.md).

[^long]: The long note has two paragraphs.

    Its second paragraph is indented.

Text after the definitions.
